latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of workspace-hygiene.

- Audits and maintains workspace file structure, memory quality, and project documentation.
- Checks for structure violations, memory health (formats, gaps, bloat), and missing project READMEs.
- Validates recent memory entries for required RAG-friendly tagging.
- Generates a health report highlighting violations and suggested actions.
- Auto-consolidates timestamped memory files; flags other issues for manual review.
- Designed for on-demand or weekly (Monday) execution per agent or globally.
